title: Digital Inputs: Pushbuttons & Internal Pullups
summary: Sense physical button presses without phantom triggers! Learn the secret of INPUT_PULLUP and debouncing.

steps.title: Buttons and Open Circuits
steps.markdownContent: A tactile pushbutton is an electrical drawbridge. When pressed, it connects two contacts and lets current cross!

steps.title: The Floating Pin Trap
steps.markdownContent: If an input pin isn't connected to either 5V or GND, it **floats** like an antenna, picking up radio waves and triggering randomly! We must tether it with a resistor.

steps.title: INPUT_PULLUP to the Rescue
steps.markdownContent: Arduino has built-in 20kΩ pullup resistors! When you configure `pinMode(2, INPUT_PULLUP);`, the pin defaults to `HIGH`. When you press the button to GND, it reads `LOW`!
